objects.description: red split rocker switch labeled BAT / ALT at the lower left of the instrument panel; up = ON
round fuel selector at the bottom right of the panel with positions OFF and BOTH and a white pointer
red ribbed plunger knob labeled MIXTURE at the bottom center of the panel; pushed in = RICH, pulled out = IDLE CUTOFF
key switch at the left of the panel with positions OFF, R, L, BOTH, START
the piston engine; its state shows on the tachometer (RPM) and the propeller in the windshield
round RPM gauge right of the six main instruments, 0 to 3500 RPM
white flap lever in a slotted gate at the right of the panel, detents 0, 10, 20 and 30 degrees
rocker switch labeled LAND in the row of light switches at the bottom left of the panel; up = ON
T-handle labeled PARK BRAKE at the bottom left of the panel; pulled out = SET, pushed in = released
black round plunger knob labeled THROTTLE at the bottom center of the panel; pushed in = full power, pulled out = idle
the control yoke; pulling it raises the nose, seen as the windshield horizon dropping and the attitude indicator pitching up
airspeed indicator, the top left of the six main instruments, in knots
attitude indicator, top center of the six main instruments, blue sky over brown ground
altimeter, top right of the six main instruments, in feet
vertical speed indicator, bottom right of the six main instruments, hundreds of feet per minute
the asphalt runway with white centerline seen through the windshield

actions.visual_cue: the red BAT / ALT master rocker switch is flipped up to ON and the amber LOW VOLTS annunciator lights up while the engine is off
the white pointer of the round fuel selector turns from OFF to BOTH
the red ribbed MIXTURE knob is pushed all the way in, flush with the panel (RICH)
the ignition key is turned to START; the propeller in the windshield starts spinning and the tachometer needle rises to about 1000 RPM
the white flap lever moves down to the 10 degree detent and the flap indicator shows 10
the white flap lever is moved all the way down to the 30 degree detent and the flap indicator shows 30
the LAND rocker switch in the light switch row is flipped up to ON and the runway ahead is lit brighter
the PARK BRAKE T-handle is pushed in flush with the panel and its red SET flag disappears
the black THROTTLE knob is pushed all the way in and the tachometer needle rises to about 2300 RPM
with the airspeed needle at or above 55 knots the nose rises: the attitude indicator pitches up about 8 degrees and the runway drops away in the windshield
the nose rises (attitude indicator pitched up, horizon dropping in the windshield) while the airspeed needle is still below 50 knots and the red STALL light is lit
the plane is airborne and climbing: attitude indicator about 7 degrees nose up, airspeed near 75 knots, vertical speed needle above 500 ft/min and the altimeter rising
